description: Defines the One2MRelationship class representing a one-to-many relationship in SuiteCRM, extending M2MRelationship, with methods for adding relationships and handling self-referencing relationships.

classes.name: One2MRelationship
classes.description: Represents a table-based one-to-many relationship, handling self-referencing cases and relationship management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the relationship object, setting link definitions based on relationship type and modules.

methods.name: linkIsLHS
methods.description: Determines if a link is on the left-hand side of the relationship.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new relationship between two beans, handling self-referencing and clearing existing links.

methods.name: addSelfReferencing
methods.description: Overridden to do nothing; logic handled in add() for self-referencing relationships.

methods.name: removeSelfReferencing
methods.description: Overridden to do nothing; self-referencing removal logic is in add().
